تحتجزن (form VIII)
# تَحْتَجِزْنَ (taḥtajizna) /taħ.ta.d͡ʒiz.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَجَزَ (iḥtajaza)
# تُحْتَجَزْنَ (tuḥtajazna) /tuħ.ta.d͡ʒaz.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَجَزَ (iḥtajaza)
